titre: One move survives. Defend, or check? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Defend, or check? 👇 Only 1.Qf7+! saves the game: after Kh8 2.Qf8+ Kh7 the position repeats, a perpetual check. Any other move gets you mated (Stockfish 16, composed position). One new puzzle every day.

Analyze your own game, free: https://blundercheck.app/try?src=youtube-en
